meta.subtitle: Live exercise of the chart, diagram, and live-snippet primitives.
meta.summary: Working examples of chart, diagram, and editable snippet.

blocks.summary: Three interactive primitives: data-driven SVG charts (scatter and line), Mermaid diagrams (lazy-loaded, theme-reactive), and editable HTML/CSS/JS snippets with iframe preview.
bullets: <chart> renders scatter and line plots from a series-of-points JSON shape. SVG-only, theme-aware.
<diagram> wraps Mermaid; loads the library on demand and re-renders on theme toggle.
<live-snippet> ships an editable textarea + sandboxed iframe preview. Type to see the preview update.

blocks.title: Chart — scatter (cost vs. impact)
blocks.lead: A 2-axis plot for evaluating items along two dimensions. Series of points with optional labels.

blocks.title: Chart — line (build progress)
blocks.lead: Same primitive, line type. Tracks a metric over time.

blocks.title: Diagram — Mermaid
blocks.lead: Wrap any Mermaid source. The library is loaded lazily from a CDN on first use and cached for subsequent diagrams. Theme toggles trigger a re-render so dark/light tokens take effect.

blocks.caption: End-to-end request flow when a page loads.
blocks.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Browser
    participant Server
    participant Renderer
    participant Kit as kit.json + glossary/*

    Browser->>Server: GET iceberg.html
    Server-->>Browser: HTML stub (chrome.js + renderer.js)
    Browser->>Server: GET iceberg.json
    Server-->>Browser: page tree
    Browser->>Server: GET kit.json + glossary/*.json
    Server-->>Browser: registry data
    Renderer->>Browser: emit Custom Elements
    Note over Browser: glossary-term tooltips ready
